transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Well, what brings me in is that my sleep has just become... completely unmoored. 

At first, I was waking up after only two or three hours, drafting plans and feeling completely ready to go. But now... now I just lie awake way before dawn. My stomach gets all tight, and I have absolutely no sense of rest.
During that time when you were drafting plans in the middle of the night, did you feel unusually energetic, talkative, or like your thoughts were racing more than usual?

Yes, absolutely. It was like... well, I had this engine running inside me. Just sitting quietly felt completely impossible. So I was up way before sunrise, calling people, rewriting old proposals, and... just moving from one task to another without stopping. I definitely had a lot of energy.
How many days in a row did you experience that high-energy, active state?

I'm not entirely sure, to be honest. I... I wasn't really keeping track of the time. When you're running on that kind of energy, the days just sort of blur together. So I couldn't give you an exact number.
During those days when you had all that energy, did your actions or behavior cause any significant problems at work, with your family, or in your social life?

Yes, it really did. Um... my wife has actually had to step in and take over all of our finances. She's also been staying right by my side at home just to make sure I'm safe, because things just got so out of hand. 

And as for my social life and other obligations... well, I've just stopped showing up reliably for things. I volunteer at the museum and I'm on the arts council, but I haven't been going to those at all. I've pretty much stopped seeing my friends, too. It's just... it's disrupted quite a bit.
During that period of high energy, did you ever experience things that others couldn't see or hear, or did you hold any beliefs that others told you were not based in reality?

No, nothing like that. I... I didn't see or hear anything that wasn't actually there. And my beliefs... well, I just thought my ideas for those proposals were incredibly important. People thought I was doing too much, sure, but nobody told me I was believing things that weren't real. It was really just the intense energy.
Aside from the periods of high energy you described, have you experienced any long stretches of time where you felt persistently sad, hopeless, or lost interest in the things you usually enjoy?

Yes, I have. Um... I used to spend whole afternoons at the museum, or I'd lose myself in photography and cooking. But lately... well, I just look at my camera or the bridge table, and I feel absolutely nothing. There's no interest there at all anymore. The only thing I really feel is just the immense effort it would take to even pretend to care.
During these periods when you feel this profound lack of interest and sadness, have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living?

Yes, I have. Um... there are mornings when I just think it would be a relief if I simply did not wake up. It's... it's a very heavy feeling. I actually frightened myself enough with those thoughts that I told my wife I shouldn't be left alone right now.

During these recent periods of feeling hopeless and lacking interest, have you experienced any thoughts or beliefs that others would consider strange, or have you seen or heard things that weren't actually there?

No, I haven't had anything like that. I just feel incredibly down and empty. I haven't seen or heard anything unusual, and my thoughts are mostly just about how pointless everything feels right now, not anything strange or out of touch with reality. It's just... a very deep sadness.
